name: Bounded cited-research protocol
description: Fetches 1-5 operator-named URLs whose hosts are all on the input allowlist (https; loopback http for bounded evals only) and returns cited passages with sha256 digests plus explicit refusals. A 200 with an empty body, a timeout, a non-text payload, or an off-allowlist host is a recorded refusal, never a citation. Proposed from liustack/modsearch (K2 task-pack, MIT); no upstream code copied. No execution binding yet: registry-entry workflow is null until B2 selection binds it, so this entry alone neither installs nor promotes anything.

provenance.portedFrom: no upstream code — original adapter written for the K2 bounded-research brief; outcome inspired by liustack/modsearch (link-out only, dshfind bulk rights unresolved)
